Others Counsel for Applicant :- Shashi Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.

1 . Heard Mr. Yash Pratap Singh, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State-opposite party-1 and Mr. Harish Chandra Yadav, the learned counsel representing first informant opposite party 2.
2. Perused the record.
3. Applicant-Jitendra, who is a named and charge sheeted accused and also facing trial before court below, has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr. P. C. with the following prayer:-
Jitendra vs State Of U.P. Others on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41570317/

sentences.text: "It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that the Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to quash the cognizance order dated 14.12.2021 passed by the learned A.S.J./Special Judge (Exclusive Court, POCSO Act) Etah as well as entire criminal proceedings of S.C. No.1180 of 2021 (State Vs. Jitendra Kumar), Crime no.253 of 2021under Sections 376, 313, 504, 506 IPC & 3/4 POCSO Act, 2012, Police Station Bagwala, District Etah pending before learned A.S.J./Special Judge. sentences.text:
It is further prayed that further proceedings of the above noted case be stayed during the pendency of present case before this Hon'ble Court to meet the ends of justice,
otherwise the applicant will suffer an irreparable loss and injury."
4. On the matter being taken up, the learned A.G.A. submits that notice of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been served upon first informant/opposite party-2 on 20.10.2024.

However,
in spite of service of notice, neither any counter affidavit has been filed by first informant/opposite party-2 in opposition to this application nor anyone has put in appearance on his behalf to oppose this application even in revised call 5.

At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. representing State opposite party 1 has raised a preliminary objection by contending that applicant has not yet been summoned by court below inasmuch as neither the copy of the summoning order has been brought on record nor a challenge to the same has been laid in the prayer clause of this application.

Referring to the Full Bench decision of this Court in Father Thomos Vs. State of U.P. and another, (2011) 1 ADJ 333 (ALL) the learned A.G.A.
submits that since applicant has not yet been summoned by court below, therefore, he has no locus to maintain this application.

entities.text: Father Thomos Vs. State of U.P. and another, (2011) 1 ADJ 333 (ALL)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He, therefore, submits that present application is liable to be dismissed as not maintainable.

6. When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned counsel for applicant fairly submits that present application be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file fresh at appropriate stage.
7. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for applicant.
8. In view of above, present application is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
9. Certified copies of documents appended along with this application shall be returned to learned counsel for applicant after obtaining photo copies of the same to be kept on record.
